New plans for 400 student room development at Deptford Creekside art studio site

18/11/2026 0 Comments J Smith
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:28
Instaread

Revised plans are being drawn up for around 400 student rooms at 3-9 Creekside in Deptford.

It’s three years ago plans were submitted for 231 student rooms at 5-9 Creekside. That was approved but it’s now a case of starting all over again.

Developer Fifth State recently undertook consultation on changes which include the adjacent site at 3 Creekside. They state they’re dropping the last plan due to “a number of challenges with the existing consent”.

Those being:

• A double storey basement, requiring significant excavation and associated environmental and construction impacts.
• Commercial space located at basement levels, with limited natural light and frontages, thereby making the space unsuitable for future occupiers.
• A sunken courtyard which was impractical and uninviting, with no public access through the site.

They no longer want to build a double basement and are looking at around 400 rooms including the adjacent unit at 3 Creekside.

An Environmental Impact Assessment is being drawn up in advance of a full planning application.

If approved 400 rooms would join many within other nearby developments including:

  • 605 student rooms at Sun Wharf beside the Creek a short distance away
  • 390 student rooms at a site beside the Creek closer to the Thames.
  • 502 student rooms at Scott House
  • 300 student rooms beside the Albany Theatre

Work has also just commenced on a 27-floor tower just over the creek in Greenwich. That will see 414 student rooms.
